markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (43%)** · Ambiguous: Invasive vs Normal · Careful review
Tier 1 composite frozen section includes Normal and Benign in its conformal set [F1], with positive margin calls [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 43%, Normal 37%, Benign 16%, InSitu 4% | Split between Invasive and Normal |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign, Invasive (90% coverage) | Cannot exclude Normal or Benign |
| Reliability / OOD | 93% reliability, 86th OOD percentile [F6] | Passes QC; moderately high OOD |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent models match top call |
| Similar cases | 2/5 Invasive (40%), 3/5 InSitu [F5] | Weak neighbor consensus; InSitu nearby |

## Tissue evidence
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 0, 1, 3) · ↓ invasive · High score (−0.36) opposes invasive [F2]; 18/20 AI spot-check · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 9) · ↑ invasive · High score (+0.25) favors invasive [F3]; 19/20 AI spot-check · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 2) · ↑ invasive · Low down-concept score adds +0.23 [F4]; 0/20 AI spot-check · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Low down-concept score adds +0.18; 12/20 AI spot-check · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 4, 5) · ↑ invasive · High score (+0.15) favors invasive; 0/20 AI spot-check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-3 risk regions beats random (+0.0114 drop, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unverified (deletion 95% CI −0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); case leans on Unreliable normal lobules, mitoses, necrosis.

## Could be wrong if
- Tissue is Normal (37%) or InSitu like 3/5 neighbors (contrast case BACH_0117, 87% similarity).
- Composite frozen-section boundaries cause false inferior, medial, and lateral margin calls; stains and cell segmentation are disabled.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 9, 4, 7**: Verify stromal invasion (99%, 81%, 77% risk) versus in situ carcinoma.
2. **Regions 0, 1, 2, 3**: Confirm benign tubules and stroma (0% risk) above high-risk regions.
3. **Regions 4, 8, 9, 10, 11**: Check tumor at inferior (430 µm), medial (215 µm), lateral (108 µm) margins.
